proposal.summary: MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficient randomness in the web service authenticator, allowing a remote attacker to access the system.
proposal.cwe_quote: if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.

AV.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request technical details: exact mechanism of authentication (session token/cookie/other), examples of predictable values, reproduction steps or PoC, and whether a patch or mitigation is available; attempt to reproduce and determine scope of access gained after bypass.

evidence_quotes.quote: There is a vulnerability in MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 that can be exploited to bypass authentication.
